description:
Her full name is Asuka Shikinami Langley.
The pilot of New Evangelion Unit-02.
Due to the Curse of Eva, her physical appearance has remained perpetually at 14 years of age.
She wears a black eye patch over her left eye.

lines.text: What are you doing?
That Four-Eyed Crony has some nerve disappearing at a time like this.
My appearance has something to do with Eva's cur... Never mind, it has nothing to do with you.
Don't treat me like a child.
There are lots of weird people here. Lilins like you are rare.
As long as you're fighting, Unit Two and I will help.
I'm a bit bored, but a peaceful daily life isn't so bad either.
Bring a game console next time.
Get me a room that's farther away.
Very well. I'll protect this place as well.
Shouldn't we upgrade the defenses here, Lilin?
That's right, I'm Asuka. When the battle starts, stay behind me, Lilin.
Isn't that obvious?
Unit Two, are you listening?
Great!
Ah, thank you.
Hmm? Trying to impress me, are you?
I suppose I'll have to accept it.
Cut my hair for me. It keeps growing, and it's rather bothersome.
How do you even manage something this frustrating? It must be hard for you.

That startled me!
What was that?
Are you an idiot?
What about Four-Eyed Crony?
Are you stupid?
Got it...
Perfect timing.
Deployment confirmed.
Let's sortie.
Cover me!
Don't rush me!
Reload!
Still reloading!
Unit Two!
Charge!
Take that!
Move!
You're in the way!
Next!
Tch...
This is the worst.
That hurt...
Support fire is always late!
Mission complete. Let's head back, Lilin.
Never thought I'd wear formal attire. I'm usually ready for battle at all times.
What's Four-Eyed Crony doing in the band? Ugh, this sucks.
Hey, don't look so surprised! It stands to reason someone as talented as I could handle an instrument.
You're surprisingly laidback in situations like this, Four-Eyed Crony.
Lilin and Nikkes both seem to have an affinity for music, and that's good enough for me.

When I was a Lilin, I used to play instruments.
Why? I'm not so sure myself.
My hair is still growing... Oh well, it suits the look.
Tired? Good. I can't stand noisy things.

You're thinking of throwing a party in a place like this?
Shouldn't you decorate it some more?
So this is where you feel most comfortable... I see.
This place is halfway decent. If I get the chance... Never mind, forget I said anything.
I know that you invited me to the party, but I've never dressed like this before.
Switching to new gear!

Aren't Nikkes able to fight no matter what they wear?
So can I.
You must always be thoroughly prepared for any emergencies.
The curtain call hasn't come yet, so don't rush in with the gifts.
I've told you before not to get it twisted; I'm not a superstar.
The party's not bad, and I like your gift. Thanks.
Hold on, why are you turning down this gift? I'm not a superstar, you know.

I smile more often now?
Don't be ridiculous.

I've already adapted here, so you don't have to avoid me anymore.
